summary: Tiny 13 m kerb among bush; tight, but one car parks here.
reasons: A car parks here in Esri

best_section.where: East kerb, just north of the speed hump on the narrow riverside lane

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the east; only a small utility building 13 m away, non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: One car sits at the kerb in Esri, but the lane is narrow with trees at the edge; a van may overhang the lane.
drivers.traffic: Narrow campus lane; light traffic at night.
drivers.convention: Cars park in short runs along the lane, mainly to the north; not a firm convention here.

flags: Very short, barely a van length
Low-lying: about 7.6 m, 143 m from Brisbane River
No signs mapped on this stretch
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over and beside the section; shaded most of the day.
